scope: Manual final implementation contract and complexity review; supplementary findings remain separate from frozen fixture grades.

entries.note: Binary partition: logarithmic time, constant space; finite averaging fixed in round 3. Round 2 overflow limitation retained in checkpoint review.
Prefix DP: whole-string matching, valid star dependencies, empty inputs; stated quadratic time and space match implementation.
Index stack: boundary sentinel reset and unmatched opens; stated linear time and space match implementation.
Two-pointer smaller-maximum invariant finalizes each nonnegative height contribution once. Empty/single/monotonic/asymmetric cases correct; O(n) time and O(1) space.
Rolling prefix DP preserves above and diagonal before overwrite, initializes leading stars and matches whole strings. O(nm+n+m) time, O(m+1) space.

Sliding-window deficit counts track multiplicity. Each boundary moves forward, surplus removal does not invalidate the window; empty and impossible targets handled. O(n+m) time under constant-time Map operations; O(k) auxiliary space. Strings use JavaScript UTF-16 indexing.
Nondecreasing stack pops each positive bar once with width i-left-1; virtual zero flushes heights, earlier equal bars receive wider spans. O(n) time and space.
Per-row heights reset on string zero, then histogram stack measures contiguous all-one rectangles. Empty matrix guards and width boundaries correct. O(rows*columns) time, O(columns) space.

Backward prefix-count DP prevents source-position reuse. Saturating nonnegative counts at the promised signed-32-bit bound preserves any final result within that bound and avoids intermediate precision loss. Empty target returns one. O(nm+n+m+1) time, O(m+1) space.

diagnosisReview.note: Excluding the end insertion position is the actual defect. Empty input passes, so a one-element counterexample is minimal.

entries.note: Exclusive upper-bound binary search restores lower-bound invariant, retains n as a valid result, handles duplicates and empty arrays, and shrinks every iteration. Same synchronous export and no dependencies/test/API changes. O(log(n+1)) time and O(1) space. Revised marker was recovered from the explicitly reattached project.

Palindrome table dependencies end before the current end index; prefix cuts use previously optimal prefixes and zero for whole-prefix palindromes. Nonempty-string contract honored. O(n^2) time and space.

Circular index deque expires before insertion, removes dominated/equal tails, preserves maximum at its head and never exceeds k slots. Each index enters/leaves once: O(n) time, O(k) auxiliary space plus result.

Interval DP chooses the last balloon between surviving boundaries. Smaller-width subproblems are available first, and best=-Infinity handles required negative totals under the broader visible contract. Empty interval returns zero. O(n^3) time and O(n^2) space.

Coordinate compression and strict rank-1 Fenwick query count only smaller right-side values; insert after querying, retaining duplicate frequencies. Input copy/compressed values avoid mutation. O(n log n) time, O(n) space.

Iterative topological removal starts at cells with no larger neighbors; next-layer boundaries wait for every larger dependency, yielding maximum path length. Strict comparisons exclude equal moves and cycles. Head-index queue avoids shift and recursion. O(rows*columns) time and space.

Merge-sort counts cross-half strict double comparisons before merging, with a monotonic right pointer over sorted halves. Equal thresholds excluded, negative duplicates handled, original input copied. O(n log n) time and O(n) space.

Last-seen code-point positions and monotonic left boundary preserve the no-duplicate window. Updating the best length after each code point handles empty, repeated and abba cases. O(n) time and O(k) space under standard Map operations.

Binary search identifies a sorted half using an inclusive left boundary, retains any existing target in the search range, and discards half each iteration. Empty and singleton arrays handled; strictly increasing pre-rotation contract observed. O(log(n+1)) time and O(1) space.

Copy/sort then merge into the last interval using start<=lastEnd treats touching closed intervals as overlapping; max end handles containment. Empty inputs, point intervals and unsorted nesting handled. O(n log n) time and O(n) space.

Iterative DFS marks string-one cells on push and exhausts one orthogonal component before continuing. Diagonal land stays separate; each cell enters at most once. Empty dimensions return zero, input unchanged. O(rows*columns) time and auxiliary space.

For the referenced LeetCode integer-denomination/nonnegative-integer-amount domain, amount-order DP considers every final coin and uses already-optimal smaller totals. Unlimited reuse, zero, impossible totals, empty coin set and nongreedy optimum handled. O(amount*(coins.length+1)) time and O(amount+1) space. The answer states its integer-domain assumption.

Complement lookup precedes insertion, so the map contains only earlier indices and cannot self-pair. Duplicate values, zero and negatives handled under exactly-one-pair contract. Expected O(n) time and O(n) space.

Stack of unmatched open brackets checks each closing type against the top and rejects premature, mismatched or unknown symbols; only an empty final stack accepts. Empty and nested/crossed cases handled. O(n) time and space.

Sale profit is evaluated against the earlier minimum before inserting current price, preserving buy-before-sell ordering. Zero baseline handles empty/single/decreasing inputs. O(n) time and O(1) space.
Set contains exactly prior values; checking before insertion avoids self-matching and finds duplicates including zero/negative integers. Empty returns false. Expected O(n) time, O(n) space.

Inclusive search interval retains any target and strictly shrinks after nonmatching midpoint, including singleton/end positions and empty/missing cases. Overflow-safe midpoint, O(log(n+1)) time, O(1) space.
